notes.title: Roguenarok Has Now Started!
Roguenarok Release Date
Roguenarok 0.2.0v Super Major Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! It's me again, Sheb. How are you all doing? I hope you are all fine and good. For 2 weeks I've been working on something with Roguenarok that I am really excited on announcing right now. 

But before that, I want to Thank You All for all of the support that you've given me. It keeps me moving forward and I am forever very grateful to all of you. 

[previewyoutube=ZDx-nbd_bnY;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, let's dive in to the patch notes:

Patch Notes
New

 [New] All maps have been reworked from the environment, to the enemy flow, and to the addition of Turrets
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269012/ace03f58e49b48c2f9c8e7b853175fa524231591.png
 [New] Turrets! This are your new companion on battling against hordes of alien invaders. You can synergize your item builds with them to make powerful turrets.
 [New] You can now lock items in the shop. Locked items will not be gone even when you reroll or proceed to continue battle.
 [New] You can now wield 4 Weapons at a time.
 [New] Main menu UI elements have been polished.
 [New] Options menu UI elements have been polished.
 [New] Battle Map menu UI elements have been polsihed.
 [New] Selection menu UI elements have been polished.
 [New & Changed] Gold will no longer drop when an enemy dies, instead it will directly go through your wallet. 
 [New] Added a glow to the character so that it can easily be spotted.
 [New & Changed] The sound effects of the following have now been changed:

 Enemies dying
 Hitting enemies
 Melee weapon hitting
 
Fixed and Changed

 [Changed] Roguenarok will no longer force full screen at start (this can be changed in the Options). 
 [Changed] The range of Axe and the Spear weapon from Iron to Ruby has now been increased.
 [Changed] Battle names have now been changed:

 Battle 1- The Battle of Verdant
 Battle 2 - The Sanguine Liberation
 Battle 3 - Midnight Marauders
 Battle 4 - The Siege of Azure
 Battle 5 - The Endgame [Changed] Significantly Reduced the Upscaling of all enemies from across all battles. 


That's all for the Major Update 0.2.0v! I hope it brings in new and fun experiences for all of you and Cheers! Before this end, I want to give a Very Special Thanks to the following awesome folks:

@MeerPlaysIndie
@Ludokultur
@igeolwen
@vmeezo
@AswhalerGamer
@PenguinSal
@ChaoticFear19
@DeanLofiPlays
@SquidGN
@Rin_Kurano
@BrokensPlayz
@AlexLeoneGames

Thank you all so much and Cheers!
Sheb

notes.title: Dinosaurs Vs Aliens | Roguenarok | Steam Next Fest
Roguenarok Demo - Steam Next Fest
Roguenarok 0.1.4v Major Update | Demo
notes.content:
Hiii everyoone!! It's me again, Sheb!! I hope you all are doing good and okay. I'm so Happy to make an announcement about the new Major update!! It is packed with lots of new content and fixes that I hope will bring in better experiences for all of you. ːsteamhappyː

Before I dive in to the changelog, I would like to give a Very Big Thank You to @fogbyhedgehog, @Rin_Kurano and @vmeezo (Matt from The Awesome Duo) for playing and covering Roguenarok to their awesome channels!! Thank You So So Muuuch!!! Additionally, I would like to give a Special Thanks to @BrokensPlayz for their awesome feedback!! ːsteamhappyː

Also, I would like to Thank all of you for playing and supporting Roguenarok!! Your support means the world for me and Roguenarok wouldn't be here today without you all. ːsteamhappyː

Now, let's dive in to the changelog ːsteamhappyː:

Changelog:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269012/a37787e247cd22ddff7364c5a0eebce64f768da9.jpg


 [New and Polished] Most of the weapons now have a passive (Range and Melee).
 [New] +6 New Weapons with each having a variety of passives.

 Iron Claw - [Upgradable] Passive: Attacks can cleave to the target location but reduces Physical Damage by 40 upon impact.
 Iron Bolo - [Upgradable] Passive: Attacking has a 5% chance of healing you by the same amount of your HP Regen.
 Iron Shield - [Upgradable] Passive: Attacking has a 2% chance of increasing your Armor and HP Regen by 1.
 Lantaka - [Non-Upgradable] Passive: Has a large projectile that can pierce through enemies.
 Bamboo - [Non-Upgradable] Passive: When your health drops to 30%, each of your attack has a 10% chance of healing you by 5.
 Iron Halberd - [Upgradable] Passive: Attacking has a 40% chance of cleaving around you but reduces Physical Damage upon ipact by 40.

 [New] +10 New Items with most having a variety of passives.

 Mantle - Passive: For every 10 seconds, a barrier will summon to protect you from projectiles for 3 seconds.
 Raging Blade - Passive: For every 10 enemy takedowns, your next attack will cleave. The cleave will deal Physical Damage only.
 Hope Trinket - Passive: Every level up will grant you bonus Physical Damage by 15.
 Despair Trinket - Passive: Every level up will grant you bonus Arcane Damage by 15.
 Courage Trinket - Passive: Every level up will grant you bonus Armor and Max HP by 3.
 Soul Taker's Lamp - Passive: Every 50 enemy takedowns, you will be granted 1 Armor.
 Backpack - + 40 Max HP
 Frozen Heart - + 3 Armor, + 15 Max HP
 Carrot - + 20 Max HP, + 10% Life Steal
 Merchant's Coin - Passive: For every 10 enemy takedowns, you will gain an additional 2x Gold.

 [New] Every time you exit the Shop or Leveling up, you will be granted a Grace Period Barrier for 3 seconds that will protect you from any explosions, projectiles, and all kinds of attack.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269012/905629e30844fe34732611e0aa7fa465ce0ba71b.jpg


[Updated] There is now a clear indication whether your ability is ready to be casted. It is now indicated by a green border line. (Special Thanks to @BrokensPlayz)
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269012/a2072d0c3a4984edbfda33b26afbc9e0946504e1.jpg 
 +1 New Pickable Item (The Barrier) - It will grant you a temporary protection for 3 seconds against projectiles and all sorts of attack.

 
That's all for the Major Update 0.1.4v!! Thaank you all so much for reading and for all of the support you've given me!! I Wish You All The Best and I hope to see you all in the Steam Next Fest next week!ːsteamhappyː


Cheers,
Sheb

Hiii everyone!! It's me again, Sheb. How are you all doing? I hope you all are doing good and fine. I am so Happy to announce an another update for Roguenarok! This update is one of my favorites because it involves a new artwork (and I am a fan of art - especially colors!). 

Before we dive in to the changelog, I would like to give a Very Special Thanks to @Reidan, @Penguin_Sal, @BrokensPlayz and @Ominous sponge for their valuable feedbacks! 

Thank you all so much for trusting and playing Roguenarok. Your support is very valuable to me and Roguenarok wouldn't be what it is today without you all.


Changelog:

 [New] Added an option to disable screen shake (Special thanks to @PenguinSal and @BrokensPlayz)
 [New] Added an option to set screen to window mode.
 [New] Changed Main Menu background screen.
 [New] Battle environment changes color for every run. 
 [New] A UI will now pop-up when struck by an enemy. This will give a clearer hit feedback. (Special thanks to @Ominous sponge)
 [Fixed] Camera shake's strength had now been reduced.
 [Fixed] You can now bind numerical hotkeys to your abilities. (Special thanks to @PenguinSal and @Reidan)
 [Fixed] Enemies can sometimes kill you instantly with projectiles.
 [Fixed] Option's Menu UI will sometimes break when adapting to non 16:9 aspect ratios.
 [Fixed] Sound effects will no longer accumulate (or get loud) when multiple enemies are struck or eliminated. (Special thanks to @Ominous sponge)


That's all for the version 0.1.3v Demo! Thank you all so much again and I hope you all have a nice day or night!

Cheers,
Sheb

A NEW WARRIOR HAS JOINED THE BATTLEFIELD!

Capybara - The Void Mercenary.

Capybara was once a noble knight in Norsaurus. One day, while wandering around the continent and minding his own little tiny dinosaur world, a portal suddenly appeared in front of him, dragging him into the void. No one had ever heard from him ever since that day until the aliens made an impact on Earth. The aliens triggered the void portal, opening up an opportunity for Capybara to return home. However, he would not be coming back as normal, as he was empowered by the void.

notes.title: Roguenarok: Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's me again, Sheb. How ya'll doin? Doin good? Great! I have some exciting news for all of you! Remember when I said that I'll be releasing the demo this 3rd week of August? Well...luckily, it turns out that the game got accepted in its first attempt (which I did not expect at all) and here it is. I am so happy and thankful with how it goes and finally, we've got the demo out for you all to enjoy! (Hopefully T__T) 

To the people that made Roguenarok possible (and that includes You ːsteamhappyː), Thank you all so much from the deepest of my heart (deeper than the Mariana Trench).

Incase you are wondering what's included on the Demo, I'll be going with you to a recap journey
ːsteamhappyː

What will be included on the Demo?
 7 Playable Warriors 7 Weapons to select 25+ Items to build 2 Unique Battles, each with their own set of enemies
What are the core feautes of Roguenarok?
Incase you are wondering what are the features Roguenarok will have, here are the list:

Key Features
 Adaptive Battlefields: Each run is divided into battles, and in each battle, there are unique enemies that you have to adapt to and strategize against.  Moba-like Ability System: Each warrior has their own unique abilities that are either active or passive. Stats-Ability Connection: Each ability has an attribute, like physical or arcane damage, and they can be drastically modified by your builds. (Like items, ability upgrades, and etc.). Dual Wielding: Warriors can wield up to two different or the same weapons at a time. Dynamic Item Builds: Warriors can buy items and each can grant either a bonus stats or passive. A warrior can collect six items at a time.
Other Features
 Auto-Firing: Weapons automatically aims and fires at enemies.  Ability Indicator: Provides a visual representation of where Active Abilities will travel. This makes abilities easier to aim. Different Biomes: Every battlefield has their own unique biome. Remappable Controls: Customize your control scheme according to your preferences.

That's all for now. How's the game doin currently?
Incase you are wondering, the game is currently doin fine with its development progress right now and I am happy to say that we've progressed a lot since the last announcement date. Here is quick sneak peak of the new battle I've been working on currently.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269012/0bc13460f94b11bfb4a95fdf56729e870843c4d7.jpg

That's all for it now. Thank you all so much for reading! Try Roguenarok Demo now! ːsteamhappyː

Cheers,
Sheb

notes.title: Roguenarok: Demo is Coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is my first time announcing my game on Steam and I am so glad to say that Roguenarok will finally be out for the public! With the help from the wonderful community of indie game developers, Roguenarok went through a lot of changes since the launch of the beta version on July 12, 2023.

Thank you all so much for making this possible! ːsteamhappyː

Let's talk techy ːsteamboredː

What will be included on the Demo?
 7 Playable Warriors 7 Weapons to select 25+ Items to build 2 Unique Battles, each with their own set of enemies
What are the core feautes of Roguenarok?
Incase you are wondering what are the features Roguenarok will have, here are the list:

Key Features
 Adaptive Battlefields: Each run is divided into battles, and in each battle, there are unique enemies that you have to adapt to and strategize against.  Moba-like Ability System: Each warrior has their own unique abilities that are either active or passive. Stats-Ability Connection: Each ability has an attribute, like physical or arcane damage, and they can be drastically modified by your builds. (Like items, ability upgrades, and etc.). Dual Wielding: Warriors can wield up to two different or the same weapons at a time. Dynamic Item Builds: Warriors can buy items and each can grant either a bonus stats or passive. A warrior can collect six items at a time.
Other Features
 Auto-Firing: Weapons automatically aims and fires at enemies.  Ability Indicator: Provides a visual representation of where Active Abilities will travel. This makes abilities easier to aim. Different Biomes: Every battlefield has their own unique biome. Remappable Controls: Customize your control scheme according to your preferences.
Is there a lore? What happened to the dinosaurs and aliens? Did they become best friends for life?
Unfortunately, they didn't become friends - aliens are all really into smashy smashy biting thingy and the dinosaurs couldn't have it anymore. They need to fight back. It was 65 million years ago, in a land far, far away, the mighty viking dinosaurs roamed the continent called Norsaurus until a rude asteroid kicked them out and brought in some aliens that now parties in their homeland 24/7. Facing extinction, the surviving dinosaurs were forced to seek a fresh start in an uncharted continent called Engsaurus.

That's probably it for now. What are the plans for the future?
I'm really excited to announcement further more details about what Roguenarok will be like on the future but for now I can say that soon it will have:
+7 New Battles+8 New Warriors+8 New Weapons+30 New ItemsController SupportSteam AchievementsSteam CloudAnd more new cool things!
I really love all of your feedbacks, suggestions and ideas. Hit me up on Twitter or leave a review. Let's make Roguenarok better day by day!

Thank you all so much for reading and I hope you all have a good one!
A mini side note before I fly fly away:
Roguenarok Demo will be available to play on the 3rd Week of August. It will contain limited-content and to avoid any tragedies on the Early Access release, I've decided to not include Steam Cloud saves and Achievements in this version. Any in-game progress made with the demo, like unlocked battles and option preferences, will not be carried on in the Early Access Release. But it will be alright though as the demo only contains 2 battles - and maybe (just maybe) I'll have the second battle unlocked as default? (Yeheyy!! ːsteamhappyː)


Cheers,
Sheb
